description:
The Master Mind Scholarship is KU Leuven's flagship award for outstanding international master's students, cutting tuition to the EU/EEA rate and adding an allowance of EUR 10,000 per year. The 2027-2028 round opens late in 2026 with a deadline around February — the scholarship page carries the confirmed dates each season.

Programme Highlights

  • Tuition at the EU/EEA level plus EUR 10,000 annual allowance
  • Requires a prior degree from a university outside Belgium with strong grades
  • Annual round tied to the master's admission application
  • Available across most KU Leuven international master's programmes

Who Should Apply

International students with excellent academic records applying to KU Leuven or UHasselt master's programmes; a high GPA from the prior degree is essential.

Funding and Costs

Tuition fee reduced to the EU/EEA level plus a EUR 10,000 allowance for international scholarship holders.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply for the master's programme first, then follow the Master Mind scholarship instructions on the KU Leuven scholarships page by the announced deadline.
